summary: This directory serves as the parsing layer for the analysis module, responsible for transforming raw source code structures and markers into structured, analysis-friendly representations used by the broader documentation and code processing pipeline.
responsibilities: Extract and normalize generator markers from source text
Identify and compute protected code regions
Parse and normalize JSDoc structures and tags
Convert raw AST data into structured analysis objects
relationships: The parser transforms raw AST nodes and string content into normalized structures.
Protected region identification relies on the parsing of specific markers within the source code.
Normalized JSDoc structures encapsulate both tag-specific data and analysis-friendly metadata for further processing.
designDecisions: Normalization of raw input into consistent internal data structures
Decoupling of structural parsing from domain-specific analysis logic
Retention of raw data alongside parsed structures for future reconstruction
